t: Joyful King: Significance and symbolism
s: December 18, 2024 - The term "Joyful King" in the Purana context refers to two instances of emotional uplift in royal figures. First, it describes King Harishcandra, who experiences profound joy upon realizing he has regained his life through his steadfast obedience. Second, it pertains to King Kusika, who feels a sense of happiness and relief upon receiving positive news from Cyavana.
